cohort: The study enrolled 425 pregnant women who underwent induction of labor, divided into a group with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and a normotensive pregnancies group.
finding: Compared to normotensive pregnancies, women with HDP undergoing IOL exhibited significantly higher rates of cesarean section and neonatal intensive care unit transfer, as well as an increased risk of mediolateral episiotomy.
mod_finding: Women with HDP had an increased risk of cesarean section after IOL, and HDP, parity, Bishop score, and birth weight were identified as factors associated with failed IOL.
